<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The following rotations are intended to achieve NM Grandmaster CA timers assuming a melee base. Non-melee P1 rotations are provided as examples but may be slower. With a non-melee base, you may need to improvise with other abilities on P3/P5.</nowiki></p>

</nowiki>
